title.suggested: Editorial Urges Tom Allen to Quit Prize Fighting

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican urged Allen to divide the stakes with McCoole rather than fight again, quit prize fighting, sell his saloon and open a genteel sparring school, praising his manly conduct.

metadata.notes: masthead reads The Missouri Republican, St. Louis, June 24, 1869

facts.fact: The Missouri Republican editorially urged Allen to give up prize fighting, sell his saloon and open a sparring school, while parties were working to renew the Allen-McCoole fight

notes: Same editorial as 328, which is cropped short on the right; this is the better copy.
